title: Melting Ghost Wolf Eclipse
description: A surreal painting shows a large blue ghost with yellow eyes and orange drips melting over a green wolf head with a third eye. Above them is a massive dark vinyl record with a bright central light and radiating lines, surrounded by yellow and orange lightning. Below are lily pads with red spiders, red flowers, disco balls, theater masks, and bubbles on a dark green and black background.
